scope: Local macOS UI checks on identical selected syntax cases from project fixtures. A rendered SVG error panel counts as error; plain source text counts as source. This is example coverage, not language conformance.

MarkViewer.mode: Default live editor, cursor moved out of code block. Read-only rendering is a separate mode. No plugins.

MDVu.mode: Native macOS preview, dist/mdvu.app; each case visited through TOC. No plugins.

D073.detail: The standalone zenuml alias is not routed to Mermaid.

MacDown 3000.mode: Preview pane; syntax highlighting, Mermaid and TeX enabled. Mermaid 11.12.1. No plugins.

Typora.mode: Stock live preview; Mermaid 11.13.0; no plugins. Diagram rendering awaited after file open.

Obsidian.mode: Stock reading view, Mermaid allowed for isolated fixture vault; no community plugins. All virtualized preview sections scrolled into view; only SVG output counts.
